thorin_1.m: What's this, a visitor? How unexpected.

thorin_2.m: Tell me, what can Thorin do for you?
r: Mind if I use your bed over there to rest?
Do you have anything to trade?

thorin_decline.m: Too bad. Good day to you then.

thorin_rest_n.m: My bed? No, that's mine. Maybe I will let you use it if you help me with a small task.

thorin_rest_y.m: Please, go ahead. You may rest here as much as you like.

thorin_return_1.m: My friend returns. What can Thorin do for you?
r: Mind if I use your bed over there to rest?
Do you have anything to trade?

thorin_search_1.m: Welcome back. Did you find all six of them?
r: No, not yet. I am still looking.
Yes, this is what I found.
Mind if I use your bed over there to rest?
Do you have anything to trade?

thorin_search_2.m: OK then. Please return when you have found them all. I would go search myself if those nasty bugs weren't there.

thorin_search_c_1.m: Thank you. I would have gone myself if those nasty bugs weren't there. This turned out to be much easier though.

thorin_search_c_2.m: As a token of my appreciation, you are welcome to use the bed over there to rest. Also, if you are interested in healing, I might be able to provide some help.
r: I think I should use the bed to rest right now. Thank you.
Do you have anything to trade?

thorin_story_1.m: You see, me and my fellow gatherers were out investigating the poisonous nature of the irdegh.

thorin_story_10.m: If you could find me their remains, I would be most grateful. Maybe I could continue my investigation based on their remains. Hmm, yes that would be great.
r: Sure, find their remains. Sounds easy enough, I'll do it.
I'm all for finding dead things. I'll do it.
Hmm, this sounds a bit shady to me. I'm not sure I should do this.

thorin_story_11.m: Excellent. Bring me back the remains of all six of them. I would go search myself if those nasty bugs weren't there.

thorin_story_2.m: Apparently, I was the only one that was careful enough when handling our wares.

thorin_story_3.m: The others got ill quite quick, and we hid in this cave to rest up. However, we had not anticipated these bugs in here.

thorin_story_4.m: Those 'scaradon' things are tough! They did not even seem to take any damage when I hit them.

thorin_story_5.m: So, that's where I am now. The people that sent us to investigate told us to set up camp if we encountered any problems, and they would come help us.

thorin_story_6.m: So far, you are the first visitor here for quite a while.
r: You don't seem all that upset that your friends died.
Anything I can do to help you meanwhile?
Tough luck. I bet help will be here any day now. Goodbye.

thorin_story_6_1.m: Nah, it's just business. Just business.
r: Anything I can do to help you?
Tough luck. I bet your rescue will be here any day now. Goodbye.

thorin_story_7.m: Hmm. Yes, actually there is something that you could do for me.

thorin_story_8.m: The others that I was travelling with, they did not make it this far into the cave, but got attacked by those bugs closer to the entrance.

thorin_story_9.m: Considering how they died, I would be very interested in seeing what effects both the irdegh and the scaradons had on them.

thorin_trade_n.m: No. I might have something to trade if you help me with a small task.

thorin_trade_y.m: Oh yes. The upside of this cave is that it literally is crawling with dead bodies of those scaradon bugs.

thorin_trade_y2.m: By chance, I happened to find out that with the right mixture, they can be made into a healing substance.
r: Let's see what you have to trade.

thorin_what_1.m: Oh, not much. Well actually, I am waiting for someone - or rather, some people.

thorin_who_1.m: Oh, I did not introduce me, my apologies. I am Thorin.

thorin.20: In a cave to the east, I found a man called Thorin, that wants me to help him find the remains of his former travelling companions. I should find the remains of all six of them and return them to him.
thorin.31: I have found some skeletal remains in the same cave that I met Thorin in.
